verdict.rationale: The Auth0 migration tooling explicitly performs bulk operations — exporting/importing many users, organizations, and SSO connections in one package (workos-docs-6, workos-docs-18, workos-docs-37) — showing WorkOS can handle bulk item operations. However, there is no evidence of general-purpose bulk API endpoints (batch create/update/delete) for everyday use, nor documentation tying bulk operations to AI-agent/MCP workflows specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch API documentation, evidence of bulk operations invoked via the MCP server or SDK for AI-native agent use, and independent confirmation of bulk-operation reliability at scale.
